name: Kounai Shasei vol.2 - Bishoujo Kamen no Nazo: Bishoujo Kamen Kenzan!
original_name: 校内写生 2巻 美少女仮面の謎：美少女仮面見参！
source:
As hero returns the fee to the town chief he hears a story about a masked girl who attacks men at night. He is promised 50,000 yen if he brings the chief the mask taken from the girl. And so the hunt starts.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-july-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角向镇长交还报酬时，听说有一名蒙面少女会在夜间袭击男性。镇长答应，只要主角夺下少女的面具并带回来，就支付5万日元。于是，一场狩猎就此开始。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-july-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
